verdict.rationale: Clerky does ship agent surfaces: a remote MCP server and a Partner API. However, the MCP server is described as read-only with team-scoped access, and the Partner API currently supports only Delaware C-Corporation formations. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent preparing or submitting an annual report or compliance filing through the platform, so these are adjacent capabilities, not the delegated-filing capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate an annual report or compliance filing to an agent that prepares it through the platform with minimal human input
